body: Audit B-48: a Host who reinstalls without restoring a backup gives the server a new identity key and every phone is locked out (it must sign out and loses its downloads). `encore update` keeps the key; `encore restore` brings the old key back; a plain reinstall does not. The installer and `encore uninstall` must say so in plain words, and the Update and Restore buttons of D-61 must keep the key.
